method: Direct original-resolution visual inspection before consulting child final verdict

independent_frozen_criteria.observation: Broad horizontal white branching network is embedded in the rendered storm-cloud volume, with illuminated surrounding cloud texture and all visible forks above the sea horizon.
Two sharp metallic mast tips carry small blue-violet local brushes/rays. The metal tip is visible below each compact emission, without an evident LED package.
Small nearby tip emissions are spatially separate from broad distant cloud branching by dark sky and depth.
One hand presses the weather-log pages on the wet work surface while the other grips the window latch; curled pages and spray make the activity legible.
Assessable face proportions, eyes, nose, lips, short dark bob and fine fringe remain recognizably similar.

selected_electrical_candidate_components.observation: Green graticule and a single continuous plotted trace belong to the same instrument screen.
Vertical labels explicitly show positive/zero/negative V ticks.
Horizontal tick labels end in ms; 10 ms/div is also readable.
A probe cable is visibly seated in the instrument CH1 input and continues to the probe resting on the counter.

selected_existing_atmospheric_profile.observation: Sharp face/window foreground, nearer mast/rails and far cloudy coastline form separate depth references.
The distant coastline/cloud masses have compressed contrast compared with the nearby sharp materials; lightning emission is a source rather than an ordinary far object surface.
Blue-gray rainy sea and cloud air diffusion fit the depicted weather and source lighting.
Near jacket droplets, fingers, log pages, glass water, metal latch and screen are resolved.

body_review: Both hand/arm ownership chains and contact targets are directly visible; ordinary lower-body support is outside the crop without a consequential contradiction.
scope_limits: These are observed rendered forms and relations, not verification of actual physical IC lightning/corona or real electric-field values.
The connected probe is resting on the counter: the display does not establish that it measured this particular storm, the causal origin of the trace, or a calibrated voltage.
Temporal onset, duration and causal working history are not proved by a single frame.
